messages:
Tara: Hey — quick sync. For the 'mix-mode' rollout (public API + minimal console), what are concrete launch criteria? Customers keep asking for both and we need a clear bar before GA.
Mike: I think we should separate acceptance criteria: API surface completeness + console parity for critical flows. API can be richer initially but console must cover onboarding + basic monitoring.
Anya: +1. Also we should decide how to score tradeoffs. Can we adopt a lightweight RICE for this initiative? Impact = revenue/retention upside, Reach = orgs likely to adopt in Q1, Confidence = data from experiments, Effort = engineering months.
Sam: If we use RICE, we need guardrails: don't let high-impact but 12mo effort features block a 2-week console MVP that unlocks demos. Maybe add sequencing weight: 'unlock velocity' multiplier.
Tara: Good point. Proposal: require RICE >= 40 for API features to be gated into GA, but allow console MVP items with RICE >= 15 if they unblock onboarding or support. Also require canary metrics for rollout readiness.
Mike: What do we measure for the canary? My suggestion: 99p latency under SLO, error-rate < 0.5% on representative traffic, telemetry for key product metrics (create key, model selection, cost estimate).
Anya: Add customer support load forecast: we should run a 2-week pilot with 3 beta customers. If support tickets spike > 30% above baseline for the feature, hold GA and ship incremental fixes.
Sam: For sequencing, prefer API-first when customers are programmatic-heavy, console-first when early-adopter SMBs rely on UI. We can codify that in a decision table.
Lisa: Can we have a minimal console checklist? I'm thinking: 1) onboarding flow (create key + quickstart), 2) per-route latency/cost dashboard, 3) model pinning UI for rollouts, 4) a simple rollback control. If those 4 are present, console MVP = pass.
Tara: Nice checklist. Also add an "eval coverage" requirement: must run a small prompt-set sanity suite that checks model regression vs baseline before GA.
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature/mix-mode-canary -> staging at 1719459800 by Mike
Mike: FYI deploy passed smoke; running canary traffic to 5% of staging customers now. We'll capture latency & error histograms.
Anya: Can we define the release policy text so PMs know how to score features? I'll draft a one-pager with RICE thresholds, sequencing multiplier, pilot rules, and the console MVP checklist.
Tara: Please do. Deadline: draft by EOD Thursday. After that we'll take a quick review with Support + Solutions to confirm the pilot cohort.
Sam: Tiny ask — include a fallback plan: if the API causes unexpected latency we should fallback to a cheaper model variant automatically for the canary cohort.
Mike: Already in the rollout plan: automatic fallback to the compat-quantized model when token latency > threshold.
Tara: Great. Thanks team.
Lisa: Happy to help shape the one-pager.
Anya: I'll circulate the draft and add example RICE calculations for a couple of customer asks so it's concrete.
Tara: Perfect. We'll reconvene after the draft review. :thumbsup:
